clue.text: Extracting a bit of collagen daily may be a plan

parts.note: taking out a small run of letters describes a hidden-word device, so these words supply the first word of the answer: concealed
the letters A-G-E-N-D-A run across these two words, collAGEN DAily, so they supply the list of business

explanation.surface: A health tip: a daily pinch of collagen might be part of somebody's regimen.
explanation.walkthrough: AGENDA sits concealed in collAGEN DAily, so extracting it reveals an agenda that was hidden: the clue's own device names the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A secret motive or scheme someone pursues behind a public front is a concealed plan.

clue.text: Understanding boundaries of Indian tourist attraction

indicators.note: the boundaries of a word are its outermost letters, first and last

parts.note: the sights are what tourists go to see, so one attraction is a sight

explanation.surface: Visiting a famous Indian monument gives a traveller a deeper grasp of the country.
explanation.definitionFit: Insight is a perceptive grasp of something, a deep comprehension.

clue.text: Laid out right-winger for wasting time

indicators.note: laid out suggests spread or rearranged, so the letters of 'Laid' are put in a new order

parts.note: a Tory is a member of the UK's right-of-centre Conservative Party

explanation.surface: Someone knocked a right-wing politician flat for dawdling.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Laid out' reads as knocked down, but 'out' is the anagram signal; 'right-winger' is a politician, not a footballer.
explanation.definitionFit: Dilatory describes someone slow and delaying, tending to dawdle.

clue.text: Rising star may keep northern women in order

indicators.note: to keep something is to hold it within, so one piece goes inside the other
in a down entry, rising means the word is written from the bottom upwards, so backwards

parts.note: the sun is our nearest star

explanation.surface: A rising star might be good at keeping order among northern women.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rising' turns SUN into NUS, and 'may keep' places N inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Members of a religious order of women, living under vows, are nuns.

clue.text: Insecure link offered by relative speed

parts.note: a grandmother is a family relative
a knot is a unit of speed used at sea, one nautical mile per hour

explanation.surface: A relative offers a shaky connection in a hurry.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Insecure link' is a knot that slips easily, a reef knot tied the wrong way.
explanation.definitionFit: This knot is a badly tied reef knot known for slipping, so it is an unreliable tie.

clue.text: Nick cannot change on the inside

indicators.note: the answer sits within the letters of the words 'cannot change'

explanation.surface: Someone named Nick refuses to change his inner self.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Nick' looks like a name but means a small cut.
explanation.definitionFit: A nick is a small cut or indentation, exactly a small V-shaped mark.

clue.text: A case of lawyers accepting endless desire for recesses

indicators.note: accepting means taking something in, so one piece goes inside the other
the case of a word is its outer shell, its first and last letters
endless means the final letter of the word is dropped

parts.note: to covet is to desire

explanation.surface: A briefcase of legal papers taking in some longing for a holiday break.
explanation.walkthrough: 'A case of lawyers' reads as a legal matter, but 'case of' means the outer letters; 'endless' drops the last letter of the desire word, and 'accepting' places it inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Alcoves are small spaces set back into a wall, so recesses is a synonym.

clue.text: Person just looking for skipper to support opportunities

indicators.note: in a down entry the supporting piece sits underneath, so it comes after

parts.note: a window is a period of opportunity, as in a window for talks
one who skips is a hopper, in a jocular sense

explanation.surface: A ship's captain is looking for chances to back someone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'skipper' suggests a captain but here is one who hops.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone browsing displays in shops without intending to buy is just looking.

clue.text: Soldiers in pink? It's a religious belief

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, a British army corps
a pink is a flower of the dianthus family, such as a carnation

explanation.surface: Troops dressed in pink: surely that is a matter of faith.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pink' is a flower, not a colour: carnations belong to the pink family.
explanation.definitionFit: Rebirth of a soul in a new body is a tenet of Hinduism and Buddhism.

clue.text: Hormone produced by offence mainly at home

indicators.note: mainly means most of the word, its last letter dropped

parts.note: an insult gives offence
to be in is to be at home

explanation.surface: A hormone triggered by being mostly insulted in one's own house.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mainly' means most of the word, so the offence loses its final letter before 'at home' is added.
explanation.definitionFit: Insulin is the pancreatic hormone that regulates blood sugar.

clue.text: Help for a newsreader reporting traffic tailback?

indicators.note: reporting suggests speech, so what is heard is the spelling

parts.note: a tailback of traffic is an auto queue, a line of cars

explanation.surface: A newsreader gets help from the screen while reading out the traffic jams.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reporting' signals sound: AUTO QUEUE said aloud matches the newsreader's prompter.
explanation.definitionFit: This prompting device scrolls the script in front of a presenter's camera.

clue.text: Number required to understand study of computer systems

parts.note: dig is slang for understand or appreciate
IT is information technology

explanation.surface: You need a number to make sense of computing studies.
explanation.definitionFit: A digit is a single numeral from zero to nine.

clue.text: Hairy bikers finally finding safe place after topless race

indicators.note: after places the following pieces behind the race piece
topless means the first letter is removed

parts.note: a run is a race

indicators.note: finally picks the last letter of the word

parts.note: a haven is a refuge, a safe place

explanation.surface: Hairy bikers reach shelter at last after a race with no tops on.
explanation.walkthrough: 'topless' cuts RUN to UN; 'finally' takes S from bikers.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone unshaven has stubble or a beard, so is hairy-faced.

clue.text: Current device developing in all operas except the first

indicators.note: developing means changing form, so the letters are rearranged
except the first means the opening letter of the phrase is left out

explanation.surface: A new electrical gadget is being created across every opera production.
explanation.walkthrough: 'except the first' drops I from 'in all operas', and 'developing' rearranges NALLOPERAS.
explanation.definitionFit: A photovoltaic sheet produces electric current from sunlight, so it is a current-making device.

clue.text: They may be turned on, seeing women streak or stupidly crossing wicket

indicators.note: crossing means stretching across, so the rearranged letters go around the other piece
stupidly suggests a muddle, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: W is the cricket abbreviation for wicket

explanation.surface: Women seeing a streaker cross the cricket pitch may get excited.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stupidly' scrambles 'streak or', and 'crossing' wraps that round the wicket's W. To turn on the waterworks is to start crying.
explanation.definitionFit: Tears, as in the idiom of turning on the taps to cry, are things switched on deliberately.

clue.text: First-class returns on a small part of our planet

indicators.note: on means placed after, the turned piece following the others
returns means the letters are written backwards

parts.note: A1 is a term for first-class, written AI

explanation.surface: First-class flights come back after a short trip somewhere.
explanation.definitionFit: A continent is a major region of the Earth.

clue.text: Find out about article made of skin

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so one piece goes around the other

parts.note: to learn is to find out
the is the definite article

explanation.surface: Discover the facts concerning a piece of skin.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Find out' looks like an instruction but is the synonym; 'about' wraps it round the article.
explanation.definitionFit: Leathern is an old adjective for made of leather, i.e. of tanned hide.

clue.text: Gangster going after neighbour?

definitions.meaning: placed after the word neighbour it makes the word for a local district

explanation.surface: A gangster stalks the man next door.
explanation.walkthrough: The second definition is cryptic: the word that follows 'neighbour' to form a district word.
explanation.definitionFit: Hood is short for hoodlum, a violent criminal; it also completes neighbour-hood.

clue.text: Rising firm best supported by American swimmer

indicators.note: in a down entry the supporting piece goes underneath, so it comes last
in a down entry rising means read upwards, so backwards

parts.note: CO is the abbreviation for company, a firm
top means best, as in top marks

explanation.surface: An up-and-coming company's finest, backed by an American.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rising' turns CO into OC.
explanation.definitionFit: The eight-armed cephalopod swims in the sea, so it is a swimmer.

clue.text: The effect of drinking with no good Scotsman of a royal house

indicators.note: with no means a letter is taken away

parts.note: the morning-after misery from drinking too much
Ian is a typical Scottish first name

explanation.surface: A hungover Scot, feeling no good after drinking, belongs to royalty.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with no' removes G from HANGOVER, leaving HANOVER.
explanation.definitionFit: The House of Hanover ruled Britain from George I to Victoria, so the adjective means belonging to that dynasty.

clue.text: Unappreciative type who's angry about heartless nag

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so one piece goes around the other

parts.note: irate means angry

indicators.note: heartless means the middle letter is removed

parts.note: taken as written, a horse

explanation.surface: An ungrateful person flies into a rage about a cruel old horse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heartless' takes the middle letter from the nag, and 'about' puts the angry word around what remains.
explanation.definitionFit: An ungrateful person who fails to show thanks is an ingrate.

clue.text: The worst and best breaks for a driver?

parts.note: the pits is slang for the worst
the tops is slang for the best

explanation.surface: Pairing the very worst and the very best, like reviews of a holiday.
explanation.walkthrough: Both pieces are slang: 'the pits' and 'the tops'.
explanation.definitionFit: Racing drivers halt in the pit lane for tyres and fuel, taking short pauses.

clue.text: Educate at home after putting pictures up

indicators.note: after places the home piece behind the pictures piece
in a down entry up means writing from the bottom, so backwards

parts.note: art covers paintings and pictures
to be in is to be at home

explanation.surface: Teach at home once you've hung the pictures.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' reverses the pictures word in this down entry; 'putting' only joins, and 'after' puts it before IN.
explanation.definitionFit: To train someone is to teach or instruct them.

clue.text: Problematic drunk

definitions.meaning: awkward or difficult, as a corner one cannot easily escape
a slang word meaning intoxicated or merry

explanation.surface: A troublesome drunk.
explanation.definitionFit: Tight means difficult, as in a tight corner, and is also slang for intoxicated.

clue.text: Destiny of daughter getting low returns

indicators.note: returns means written backwards

parts.note: to low is to moo, as cattle do

explanation.surface: A daughter's fate, coming home to poor results.
explanation.walkthrough: 'low' is the cow's sound, not 'poor'; 'returns' turns MOO round, which reads the same.
explanation.definitionFit: Doom is one's fate or ruin, an unavoidable destiny.

clue.text: Give details of former plot to kidnap one

parts.note: ex means former

indicators.note: to kidnap is to hold someone captive, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: a plot is a plan
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Describe an old scheme to abduct somebody.
explanation.definitionFit: To explain something is to set out its particulars clearly.

clue.text: Cooking range covered in eggs and herb

indicators.note: covered in means wrapped by, so the rearranged letters go inside

parts.note: O, an egg shape, stands for egg, so two eggs are OO

indicators.note: cooking suggests something cooked up, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Something cooking on the range, coated in eggs and herbs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cooking' scrambles 'range', which 'covered in' places between the two egg-shaped Os.
explanation.definitionFit: Oregano is an aromatic Mediterranean herb used in cooking.

clue.text: Determined to see one looked after

parts.note: single means one
minded means looked after, as a childminder does

explanation.surface: Resolved to visit someone who cared for you.
explanation.definitionFit: Focused on one aim with resolve, a synonym for resolute.
